summary.text: Joshua Kolasinski, a Democratic business owner with an associate degree from Owens Community College and a bachelor's degree from Siena Heights University, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Ohio's 4th District to Jim Jordan.

paragraphs.text: Kolasinski earned an associate degree from Owens Community College and a bachelor's degree from Siena Heights University, and his career experience includes working as a business owner. He won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for Ohio's 4th District; this is his first race listed on Ballotpedia.
His campaign website listed government accountability, economic opportunity for workers, and healthcare cost reform among its main policy objectives.
He received 31.3% of the vote to Jim Jordan's 64.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
